true-plugin-builtin-distort-wave.description: Independent True Motion implementation; not an AE binary port.

true-plugin-builtin-distort-glitch.name: True Glitch
true-plugin-builtin-distort-glitch.description: Independent True Motion implementation; not an AE binary port.

true-plugin-builtin-distort-kaleido.name: True Kaleidoscope
true-plugin-builtin-distort-kaleido.description: Independent True Motion implementation; not an AE binary port.

true-plugin-builtin-distort-diffuse.name: True Diffuse
true-plugin-builtin-distort-diffuse.description: Independent True Motion implementation; not an AE binary port.

true-plugin-builtin-energy-beam.name: True Energy Beam
true-plugin-builtin-energy-beam.description: Independent True Motion implementation; not an AE binary port.

true-plugin-builtin-energy-edges.name: True Neon Edge
true-plugin-builtin-energy-edges.description: Independent True Motion implementation; not an AE binary port.

true-plugin-builtin-glow-bloom.name: True Bloom
true-plugin-builtin-glow-bloom.description: Independent True Motion implementation; not an AE binary port.

true-plugin-builtin-glow-streaks.name: True Streaks
true-plugin-builtin-glow-streaks.description: Independent True Motion implementation; not an AE binary port.

true-plugin-builtin-optics-split.description: Independent True Motion effect inspired by NodeVideo feature concepts; original shader.

true-plugin-builtin-optics-squeeze.name: True Squeeze · 挤压
true-plugin-builtin-optics-squeeze.description: Independent True Motion effect inspired by NodeVideo feature concepts; original shader.

true-plugin-builtin-optics-scan.name: True Glow Scan · 扫描光
true-plugin-builtin-optics-scan.description: Independent True Motion effect inspired by NodeVideo feature concepts; original shader.

true-plugin-builtin-optics-pixelsort.name: True Pixel Sort · 像素排序
true-plugin-builtin-optics-pixelsort.description: Independent True Motion effect inspired by NodeVideo feature concepts; original shader.

true-grade.name: True Color Grade
true-grade.description: True Motion 调色：53 个参数、色轮、RGB 曲线和六组 HSL。

huesaturation.name: Hue & Saturation
huesaturation.description: Turns colors around the color wheel and makes them stronger or weaker; vibrance strengthens the duller colors most.

brightnesscontrast.name: Brightness & Contrast
brightnesscontrast.description: Adjusts the brightness and contrast of the image.

solid.name: Solid Color
solid.description: Lays one color over the layer, keeping its shape, with a choice of blend modes.

backdrop.name: Adjustment Layer
backdrop.description: Copies what is drawn beneath the layer so later effects can change it. Mask To Layer limits the copy to the opaque parts of the layer. Mix brings the layer fill back.

gradientoverlay.name: Gradient Overlay
gradientoverlay.description: Lays a two-color gradient over the layer with a choice of shapes and blend modes.

fourcolor.name: Four-Color Gradient
fourcolor.description: Blends four colors placed at four points (in pixels from the layer's center) over the layer.

colorbalance.name: Color Balance
colorbalance.description: Pushes the shadows, midtones and highlights towards their own colors (gray leaves a range unchanged).

colorwheels.name: Lift Gamma Gain
colorwheels.description: Color wheels for the shadows (lift), midtones (gamma) and highlights (gain): a hue, how far to push it, and a level.

splittone.name: Split Tone
splittone.description: Tints the shadows towards one hue and the highlights towards another, keeping black, white and brightness.

temperature.name: Color Temperature
temperature.description: Warms or cools the picture like light of a color temperature in kelvin; 6500 K leaves it unchanged.

duotone.name: Duotone
duotone.description: Applies a two-color gradient map based on luminance with contrast and amount controls.

gradientmap.name: Gradient Map
gradientmap.description: Recolors the picture by brightness through three colors, with repeats and a phase. Scale Brightness multiplies the result by the picture's own brightness.

exposure.name: Exposure
exposure.description: Simulates photographic exposure with stops, offset, and gamma correction.

invert.name: Invert
invert.description: Inverts the color channels of the image with a blend amount and optional alpha inversion.

levels.name: Levels
levels.description: Adjusts the levels of the image with input black/white points, gamma, and output black/white points.

posterize.name: Posterize
posterize.description: Cuts each color channel into a number of flat Steps, so smooth gradients turn into bands. Offset moves where the band edges fall.

sepia.name: Sepia
sepia.description: Warm brown tones, like an old photograph.

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.description: Pure black and white, split at a brightness.

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Maps the picture's luminance between a shadow color and a highlight color with a blend amount.

colorize.name: Colorize
colorize.description: Tints the whole layer with one hue while keeping its light and shade.

palettemap.name: Palette Map
palettemap.description: Maps each pixel to the nearest color in a palette of up to eight colors. Alpha blends the mapped colors with the original layer.

ominodiffusion.name: Omino Diffusion+
ominodiffusion.description: Redraws the layer in a small palette and drags the rounding error along a direction, for a glitchy dithered look that comes alive in motion.

spotcolor.name: Spot Color
spotcolor.description: Keeps one color and takes the saturation out of every other color in the layer.

replacecolor.name: Replace Color
replacecolor.description: Replaces one color with another. Alpha controls the replacement strength; Lock Luminance keeps the light and shade of the original.

channelremap.name: Channel Remap (RGB)
channelremap.description: Rebuilds each color channel from another channel of the layer, for false color or for moving luminance into alpha.

channelremaphsv.name: Channel Remap (HSV)
channelremaphsv.description: Rebuilds hue, saturation, value and alpha from other channels of the layer.

innerblur.name: Inner Blur
innerblur.description: Blurs the picture inside the layer while keeping its outline sharp.

directionalblur.name: Directional Blur
directionalblur.description: Motion blur by averaging samples along a directional angle.

motionblur.name: Motion Blur
motionblur.description: Blurs the layer along the way it moves, turns and grows, from its keyframes and from motion effects such as Auto-Shake and Oscillate. Tune scales the blur. The preview shows a quicker blur unless Full Blur is on.

smear.name: Smear
smear.description: Smears the layer in one direction by a fixed length, as if it moved fast.

radialblur.name: Zoom Blur
radialblur.description: Applies a radial zoom blur by averaging samples along rays from a center point with adjustable strength.

zoomstreaks.name: Zoom Streaks
zoomstreaks.description: Makes streaks that shoot out from a point by scaling copies of the layer around it and keeping the brightest pixels. Average gives a zoom blur. R, G, B and A choose per channel whether the copies keep the lowest, highest or average value, or leave that channel alone.

spinstreaks.name: Spin Streaks
spinstreaks.description: Makes arc-shaped streaks by turning copies of the layer around a point and blending where they overlap. R, G, B and A choose per channel whether the copies keep the lowest, highest or average value, or leave that channel alone.

linearstreaks.name: Linear Streaks
linearstreaks.description: Makes straight streaks by sliding copies of the layer along an angle and blending where they overlap.

spinblur.name: Spin Blur
spinblur.description: Blurs the layer in circles around a point, as if it were spinning.

lensblur.name: Lens Blur
lensblur.description: A spinning blur that leaves a sharp area around the center and grows towards the edges.

maskblur.name: Mask Blur
maskblur.description: Blurs the layers behind this one inside its shape; brighter parts of the layer blur more, so a gradient makes a tilt-shift.

fillbehind.name: Fill Behind
fillbehind.description: Fills the frame behind the layer with a blurred, zoomed copy of itself, the usual fix for a portrait video in a landscape project.

twirl.name: Swirl
twirl.description: Twists the layer around Center like a whirlpool, strongest in the middle and fading out at Radius (a share of the layer size). Negative Strength twists the other way.

bulge.name: Pinch/Bulge
bulge.description: Bulges the layer out like a lens (positive Strength) or pinches it in toward Center (negative) inside a circle of Radius, a share of the layer size.

innerbulge.name: Inner Pinch/Bulge
innerbulge.description: Bulges the middle of the layer out or pinches it in, while the edges of the layer stay where they are.

glitch.name: Glitch
glitch.description: Random horizontal block displacement and color channel offsets, changing a few times per second.

noisedisplace.name: Noise Displace
noisedisplace.description: Displaces pixels using smooth value noise that animates over time.

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.description: Concentric ripples radiating from a center point with configurable amplitude, wavelength, and speed.

circularripple.name: Circular Ripple
circularripple.description: Makes circular ripples spread out from a point, like a drop falling into water.

wavewarp.name: Wave Warp
wavewarp.description: Bends the layer with a sine wave: Spacing sets how many waves cross it, Magnitude how far they push, Angle the direction the waves run and Warp Angle the direction they push.

turbulentdisplace.name: Turbulent Displace
turbulentdisplace.description: Pushes the layer around with smooth fractal noise, for fire, water, heat haze or rough natural edges.

fractalwarp.name: Fractal Warp
fractalwarp.description: Warps the layer with folded fractal noise, for fire, water and heat shimmer.

tiles.name: Tiles
tiles.description: Repeats the layer to fill the screen. Raise Crop to make smaller tiles, with optional mirroring, row offset and rotation. Legacy Scale preserves older projects.

hexagontiling.name: Hexagon Tiling
hexagontiling.description: Repeats the middle of the layer in hexagonal tiles that fill the screen.

tilerotate.name: Tile Rotate
tilerotate.description: Divides the layer into a grid of tiles and turns the picture inside every tile on its own.

tileshift.name: Tile Shift
tileshift.description: Divides the layer into a grid of tiles and slides the picture inside every tile in a random direction.

hexagontilerotate.name: Hexagon Tile Rotate
hexagontilerotate.description: Divides the layer into hexagonal tiles and turns the picture inside every tile on its own.

hexagontileshift.name: Hexagon Tile Shift
hexagontileshift.description: Divides the layer into hexagonal tiles and slides the picture inside every tile in a random direction.

squeeze.name: Squeeze
squeeze.description: Pinches the middle of the layer inward with positive Strength and bulges it outward with negative Strength. Legacy preserves the shape of older projects.

polar.name: Polar Coordinates
polar.description: Bends the layer around its center, turning straight lines into circles, or unrolls circles into straight lines.

viewer360.name: 360° Viewer
viewer360.description: Shows a 360° panorama layer through a virtual camera that you can turn and zoom.

reorient360.name: 360° Reorient Sphere
reorient360.description: Turns a 360° panorama layer around inside its sphere, to level the horizon or change where the front is.

stretch.name: Stretch Segment
stretch.description: Cuts the layer along a line and pulls the two halves apart, stretching the pixels on the line into the gap.

bend.name: Bend
bend.description: Bends the layer along a circular arc; the Origin side stays put and the far side turns to the angle you set, a positive angle to the left. Best on long, thin layers.

curl.name: Curl
curl.description: Rolls one end of the layer around a circle while the other end stays flat; animate Offset to roll or unroll it. Best on wide, thin layers.

magnifybackground.name: Magnify Background
magnifybackground.description: Makes the layer a magnifying glass: its shape shows the layers behind it enlarged around its center.

glass.name: Glass
glass.description: Turns the layer's shape into beveled glass that bends the layers behind it, with a highlight along the rim.

displacementmap.name: Displacement Map
displacementmap.description: Uses the layer's colors to push the layers behind it around, then hides itself; or, with Map set to Layer Below, pushes this layer by the layer beneath.

polardisplacement.name: Polar Displacement Map
polardisplacement.description: Turns and pulls the layers behind this one around a center point by the layer's colors, then hides the layer.

ominoglass.name: Omino Glass
ominoglass.description: Glass made from the layer's brightness: refracts what is behind it with rainbow fringes and lights the surface like a lens.

glow.name: Glow
glow.description: A halo in one color around the outside of the layer's shape. Hardness turns it from a soft fade into a solid outline.

lightglow.name: Light Glow
lightglow.description: Adds a colored glow around the parts of the picture brighter than a threshold.

softglow.name: Soft Glow
softglow.description: Screens a soft, blurred copy of the picture over it for a dreamy glow, mostly from the highlights.

innerglow.name: Inner Glow
innerglow.description: Adds a glow along the inside edges of the opaque parts of the layer.

edgeglow.name: Edge Glow
edgeglow.description: Finds the edges in the layer and makes them glow like neon over a darkened picture.

contourlines.name: Contour Lines
contourlines.description: Draws outline rings around the opaque parts of the layer, for stacked sticker or neon outlines.

contourgradient.name: Contour Gradient
contourgradient.description: Paints a two-color gradient outwards from the edges of the opaque parts of the layer, like a soft colored halo.

electricedges.name: Electric Edges
electricedges.description: Draws a crackling, glowing outline around the layer that jitters like electricity when Seed or Evolution is animated, with optional contour lines inside.

contourstrips.name: Contour Strips
contourstrips.description: Draws stacked paper strips whose height follows the layer's brightness or opacity, like a ridge-line landscape.

glowscan.name: Glow Scan
glowscan.description: Blurs and lights up only the parts of the layer whose brightness falls in a band; animate Position to sweep the glow from shadows to highlights.

ribbon.name: Ribbon
ribbon.description: Draws a twisting ribbon of changing width across the opaque parts of the layer; animate Phase to make it flow, or punch it out of the layer.

edgedetect.name: Edge Detect
edgedetect.description: Bright lines where the picture changes, dark elsewhere.

emboss.name: Emboss
emboss.description: Applies an emboss effect using luminance gradients along a specified light angle.

smoothbevel.name: Smooth Bevel
smoothbevel.description: Gives the opaque parts of the layer a smooth, rounded bevel lit from one side.

bumpmap.name: Bump Map
bumpmap.description: Lights the layer as if its brightness were a raised surface, for an embossed, textured look that keeps the colors.

roughenedges.name: Roughen Edges
roughenedges.description: Eats into the edges of the opaque parts with noise, for a torn, worn or burnt outline.

halftone.name: Halftone
halftone.description: Printed dots that grow where the picture is dark.

halftonelines.name: Halftone Lines
halftonelines.description: Redraws the layer as printed lines that get thicker in dark areas and thinner in light ones.

cmykhalftone.name: CMYK Halftone Dots
cmykhalftone.description: Redraws the layer like a magazine print: cyan, magenta, yellow and black dots on four rotated screens.

lensflare.name: Light Flare
lensflare.description: A bright light with a halo, laid over the picture.

longshadow.name: Long Shadow
longshadow.description: Casts long, parallel shadows from the opaque parts of the layer.

radialshadow.name: Radial Shadow
radialshadow.description: Casts long shadows from the opaque parts of the layer, spreading out away from a light point.

pixelate.name: Pixelate
pixelate.description: Turns the layer into blocks of one color each, taken from the middle of the block, on a grid centered on the layer (or on the frame with Screen Space). Stretch, Offset and Angle shape the grid and Vignette darkens each block toward its edges.

mosaic.name: Mosaic
mosaic.description: Divides the layer into squares and fills each one with its average color.

rgbsplit.name: RGB Split
rgbsplit.description: Splits the red, green and blue channels: the Center channel stays put and the other two shift in opposite directions along Angle. Light adds the shifted colors, Dark keeps them solid, Mask keeps only where all three overlap and Luma makes the fringes as opaque as they are bright.

scanlines.name: Scanlines
scanlines.description: Adds horizontal scanlines for a CRT monitor effect with optional vertical rolling.

stripes.name: Stripes
stripes.description: Draws a pattern of stripes over the opaque parts of the layer, or punches the stripes out of it.

voronoicells.name: Voronoi Cells
voronoicells.description: Fills the opaque parts of the layer with a pattern of cells around randomly placed points.

star.name: Star
star.description: Draws one glowing star on the layer.

checker.name: Checker
checker.description: Draws a checkerboard over the opaque parts of the layer, or punches the checkers out of it.

grid.name: Grid
grid.description: Draws grid lines over the opaque parts of the layer, or cuts them out of it.

dots.name: Dots
dots.description: Draws a random but even pattern of soft dots over the layer, or uses the layer only as a mask for the dots.

radialrays.name: Radial Rays
radialrays.description: Paints solid sunburst rays from a point over the opaque parts of the layer.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.description: Draws a forked bolt of lightning between two points on the layer.

iridescence.name: Iridescence
iridescence.description: Covers the opaque parts of the layer with a flowing rainbow sheen, like oil on water or a soap bubble.

rays.name: Rays
rays.description: Shines rays of light out from the bright parts of the layer, away from a center point.

starfield.name: Starfield
starfield.description: Fills the opaque parts of the layer with a deep field of stars. Offset moves through the field, with nearby stars moving farther than distant stars.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.description: Applies an unsharp mask using a 3x3 neighborhood to enhance fine details.

vignette.name: Vignette
vignette.description: Darkens the layer toward its edges outside a rounded shape: Size sets the shape, Roundness how round it is, Feather how soft its edge is, Strength how dark it gets and Tint how much it takes on Color. Punch Out makes the edges transparent instead.

filmgrain.name: Film Grain
filmgrain.description: Animated monochrome film grain with adjustable amount, grain size, and animation speed.

turbulence.name: Turbulence
turbulence.description: Fills the opaque parts of the layer with smooth fractal noise, for clouds, smoke or a brightness map.

clouds.name: Clouds
clouds.description: Covers the opaque parts of the layer with a soft cloud pattern, also handy as a noise source.

fractalridges.name: Fractal Ridges
fractalridges.description: Fills the opaque parts of the layer with sharp, turbulent ridges of fractal noise.

dissolve.name: Dissolve
dissolve.description: Removes random pixels or blocks from the layer. Animate Strength for a dissolve transition; Seed chooses the pattern and Size sets the size of each speck.

blockdissolve.name: Block Dissolve
blockdissolve.description: Removes random grid-aligned blocks from the layer. Animate Strength to take away more and more blocks.

blocknoise.name: Block Noise
blocknoise.description: Flickers random blocks of noise over the layer. Multiply modulates the existing colors; Add adds noise to them. Freeze holds the pattern still.

static.name: Static
static.description: Flickering gray noise, like a television with no signal.

blink.name: Blink
blink.description: Switches the layer on and off a number of times per second.

fade.name: Fade In/Out
fade.description: Fades the layer in at its start and out again at its end, over the times you set.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.description: Reflects one half of the image across a mirror line defined by an angle and a center point.

tile.name: Tile
tile.description: Repeats the picture in a grid.

chromakey.name: Chroma Key
chromakey.description: Removes one color, such as a green screen.

lumakey.name: Luma Key
lumakey.description: Removes the dark parts of the layer (or the light ones).

wipe.name: Wipe
wipe.description: Hides the layer from two opposite sides. Animate Start or End for a wipe transition.

feather.name: Feather
feather.description: Softens the alpha edges of the layer. Inward fades into the existing outline; Blur Alpha also spreads the softened edge outside it.

radialwipe.name: Radial Wipe
radialwipe.description: Hides a wedge of the layer swept round Center from Start Angle, like a clock hand. Progress is the angle swept, Count repeats the wedge round the circle and Both sweeps both ways. Animate Progress for a transition.

mattechoker.name: Matte Choker
mattechoker.description: Shrinks the opaque parts of the layer by eating into their edges.

unsharpmask.name: Unsharp Mask
unsharpmask.description: Sharpens by adding back the difference between the layer and a blurred copy of it. Strength sets how wide the blur is, Amount how much is added back, and Threshold above 50% leaves small differences alone.

highlightshadow.name: Highlights & Shadows
highlightshadow.description: Recovers or boosts bright highlights and lifts or deepens dark shadows, going by the brightness of each pixel.

darkglow.name: Dark Glow
darkglow.description: Spreads the dark parts of the layer out over the bright ones, like a glow made of shadow.

denoise.name: Denoise
denoise.description: Removes image noise with an edge-preserving bilateral filter that averages nearby pixels only when their colors are similar.

flicker.name: Flicker
flicker.description: Flickers the opacity of the layer at random.

autoshake.name: Auto-Shake
autoshake.description: Moves the layer randomly over time within the set limits.

randomdisplace.name: Random Displacement
randomdisplace.description: Automatically moves the layer smoothly but randomly over time. Seed picks a different movement, Speed sets how fast it wanders and Evolution shifts the pattern.

randomjitter.name: Random Jitter
randomjitter.description: Makes the layer jump back and forth at random along an angle.

oscillate.name: Oscillate
oscillate.description: Moves the layer back and forth along an angle, in depth or round in an orbit.

swing.name: Swing
swing.description: Turns the layer back and forth between two angles.

spin.name: Spin
spin.description: Turns the layer round and round at a steady speed; below zero it turns the other way.

pulsesize.name: Pulse Size
pulsesize.description: Grows and shrinks the layer over and over, on a sine or triangle wave.

pulseopacity.name: Pulse Opacity
pulseopacity.description: Fades the layer out and in over and over, on a sine or triangle wave.

stretchaxis.name: Stretch Axis
stretchaxis.description: Stretches the layer in any direction.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Shifts the layer's picture, wrapping it round at the edges of the layer's box.

movealongpath.name: Move Along Path
movealongpath.description: Places the layer partway along the outline of the layer just beneath it.

echo.name: Echo Keyframes
echo.description: Draws copies of the layer as it was a moment ago, following its animation.

timequant.name: Frame Rate
timequant.description: Makes this layer move at a lower frame rate, like choppy or stop-motion footage.

shutterblur.name: True Motion Blur
shutterblur.description: Blurs the layer along the way it really moves, turns and grows, like a camera shutter. A wider shutter angle gives longer trails and more samples give smoother ones. The preview shows a quicker blur unless Full Blur is on.

vhs.name: VHS
vhs.description: Looks like an old video tape: color bleed, smeared lines, scanlines, tape noise and rolling tracking bands.

cube.name: Cube
cube.description: Wraps the layer onto every face of a turning cube with rounded edges and lighting.

box.name: Box
box.description: Wraps the layer onto a box whose width, height and depth you choose.

hollowbox.name: Hollow Box
hollowbox.description: A box with open top and bottom: the layer covers the outside and the inside takes the interior color.

cylinder.name: Cylinder
cylinder.description: Wraps the layer around a cylinder and onto its round ends.

ellipsoid.name: Ellipsoid
ellipsoid.description: Wraps the layer around a sphere that you can squeeze and flatten.

torus.name: Torus
torus.description: Wraps the layer around a ring.

pyramid.name: Pyramid
pyramid.description: Puts the layer on the faces of a square pyramid.

octahedron.name: Octahedron
octahedron.description: Puts the layer on the eight faces of an octahedron.

hexprism.name: Hexagonal Prism
hexprism.description: Puts the layer on the front and back of a six-sided prism.

starprism.name: Star Prism
starprism.description: Cuts the layer into a star and gives it depth.

starpolyhedron.name: Star Polyhedron
starpolyhedron.description: Puts the layer on a star made of two crossed pyramids.

heart.name: Heart
heart.description: Cuts the layer into a puffy heart.

cross.name: Three-axis Cross
cross.description: Puts the layer on three bars that cross at the middle.

rasterextrude.name: Raster Extrude
rasterextrude.description: Pushes the layer's picture out into a solid block; the sides take the interior color.

flip.name: Flip Layer
flip.description: Turns the layer like a card in 3D, with its back see-through, a picture or a color.

spherize.name: Spherize
spherize.description: Wraps the layer onto a sphere using a front projection or an equirectangular texture.

tunnel.name: Tunnel
tunnel.description: Lines an endless tunnel with the layer and flies through it. Phase shifts the texture along its length.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer.

linearrepeat.name: Linear Repeat
linearrepeat.description: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, arranged along a line.

radialrepeat.name: Radial Repeat
radialrepeat.description: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, arranged in a circular pattern.

gridrepeat.name: Grid Repeat
gridrepeat.description: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer, arranged in a grid.

repeatalongpath.name: Repeat Along Path
repeatalongpath.description: Dynamically generates multiple copies of the layer along the outline path of the layer immediately beneath.

scatterfield.name: Scatter Field
scatterfield.description: Scatters copies of the layer within an infinite 3D field while hiding the original layer, and allows simulated motion within the field in three dimensions through keyframe animation.

datamosh.name: Datamosh
datamosh.description: Between the start and end times, in seconds from the beginning of the layer, the picture stops refreshing and is dragged around by the motion that follows, as if a key frame were missing. Video layers are smeared by their real motion, other layers by moving blocks.

textprogress.name: Text Progress
textprogress.description: Shows the text between Start and End, by character, word or line, with optional fades, slides, scaling or blur.

texttransform.name: Text Transform
texttransform.description: Moves, scales, turns, fades and tints letters, words or lines inside a range. Anchor sets whether scaling and rotation use each component or the center of the layer. Move the range with Offset to make the change travel through the text.

textrandomizer.name: Text Randomizer
textrandomizer.description: Randomly replaces Amount of the characters between Start and End. Animate Evolution or raise Speed to change the replacements; Reveal settles them back into the original text.

countupdown.name: Count Up/Down
countupdown.description: Changes every number in a text layer: multiplies it and adds to it, so keyframing Multiply from 0% to 100% counts up to the number you typed. Words around the numbers stay as they are.

timecode.name: Timecode
timecode.description: Replaces the text of a layer with a running clock of the layer or project time. Start At and a negative Speed make a countdown.

drawingprogress.name: Drawing Progress
drawingprogress.description: Draws a freehand drawing stroke by stroke, or the outline of a shape, from Start to End. Keyframe End from 0% to 100% to watch it being drawn. Works best on shapes with Fill off and a Stroke.

stroketaper.name: Stroke Taper
stroketaper.description: Thins the pen and brush strokes of a freehand drawing to a point: from nothing up to Start, and from End down to nothing. Squeeze makes the taper sharper.

true-audio-reactive.name: 音频响应
true-audio-reactive.description: 选择音频或视频图层来驱动运动，不生成关键帧。

true-particles.name: 粒子
true-particles.description: 原生粒子物理、生命周期参数和其他图层纹理。
